scope: The exterior of restored Al Jalali Fort at Old Muscat as photographed on 10 August 2024, with the full mapped fort and open court, harbor-facing gun ports, round bastions, square keep and lower approach tower.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Archnet describes the defensive towers, wall with gun ports and twentieth-century restoration.
The Portuguese-influence heritage inventory describes the two round towers and quadrangular tower.
The Oman tourism guide describes the long wall with arched openings and the harbor gun platform.
